controls.protection: Unprotected out of MIN; conveys in all scenarios
controls.notes: In a three-pick pool with CLE's and UTA's own 2027 firsts: most favorable of MIN, CLE and UTA (UTA cannot be 1-5) to MEM; second most favorable to UTA; least favorable to PHX (via UTA). UTA holds the base right; MIN's pick definitely conveys and lands with MEM, UTA or PHX depending on relative order. Spotrac: 'UTA - Second most favorable of CLE, MIN and UTA then others to MEM and PHX'.

controls.protection: UTH cannot be 1-5 (own pick shielded from the MEM conveyance if top-5)
controls.notes: UTA keeps the second most favorable of UTH (cannot be 1-5), CLE and MIN; most favorable to MEM and least favorable to PHX. UTA's own pick conveys to MEM if most favorable (and not 1-5) or to PHX if least favorable.

UTA holds two swap rights (via UTH swap for CLE; via UTH swap of UTH or CLE for LAL) and keeps the most favorable of UTH, CLE and LAL; less favorable of UTH and CLE to CLE ('[CLE may convey UTH to ATL]' per RealGM, feeding ATL's swap right on CLE/UTH); UTA's own pick can end with CLE, ATL, or LAL. Rights are favorable to UTA.

controls.protection: Unprotected out of CLE; conveys in all scenarios. RealGM: 'Most / two most favorable of CLE, UTH and MIN 6-30 to UTH; least / less favorable to CHA (via CLE and MIN to UTH; via UTH to PHX to CHA; via CHA swap of CHA, CLE or UTH for MIN)'
controls.notes: Base obligation from the Donovan Mitchell trade (CLE 2029 first unprotected to UTA). Utah has rerouted the least/less favorable of the CLE/UTA/MIN-6-30 pool to CHA (via PHX). CLE's actual pick ends with UTA or CHA depending on relative position; MIN's leg only joins the pool if MIN falls 6-30 (MIN keeps 1-5). RealGM footnote: 'CHA will also have a complex swap right with MIN and PHX will receive a least favorable pick'.

controls.protection: 1-5 Own; if 6-30, most / two most favorable of MIN 6-30, CLE and UTH to UTH then other to CHA
controls.notes: Top-5 protected. If conveyed, enters UTA's pool (UTA keeps most / two most favorable of MIN 6-30/CLE/UTH; least to CHA); RealGM footnote: 'CHA will also have a complex swap right with MIN and PHX will receive a least favorable pick'. Fallback: if MIN does NOT convey the first to UTA in 2029, UTA instead receives MIN's 2029 2nd-round pick (and CHA gets that 2nd if MIN does convey).

UTA keeps most / two most favorable of UTH, CLE and MIN 6-30; least / less favorable to CHA. UTA's own pick conveys to CHA if it is the least favorable of the pool. Footnote: CHA also holds a complex swap right with MIN, and PHX receives a least favorable pick from the CHA-MIN conveyance.
Own or swap for LAL: UTA holds the swap right (favorable to UTA); if exercised, UTA's own 2030 first goes to LAL and UTA takes LAL's.
Unprotected; to UTA in the July 2026 Walker Kessler sign-and-trade (UTA received unprotected 2031 + 2033 firsts and 2028 + 2030 swaps).
Unprotected; to UTA in the July 2026 Walker Kessler sign-and-trade. LAL's only clean own firsts 2027-2033 are 2032 and the 1-4 branch of 2027.

RealGM annotates 'Own (cannot be 1)' — a restriction annotation, not a trade obligation; Spotrac and Tankathon show the pick fully unencumbered. Provenance of the 'cannot be 1' note could not be verified (see caveats). Emitted only so the annotation is not silently dropped.

controls.swap_with: WAS holds the rights: 'via WAS swap for PHX, BRK or PHL' then 'via WAS swap of WAS, BRK, PHL or PHX for MIL or POR'; PHX receives the least favorable of WAS/PHI 9-30/BKN/PHX; MIL receives the less favorable of the second-layer comparison
controls.notes: Swap-encumbered; WAS retains a first but its own pick can convey to PHX or MIL depending on swap outcomes. RealGM exact: 'More favorable of (i) more favorable of (a) WAS and (b) least / less favorable of BRK, PHL 9-30 and PHX and (ii) less favorable of MIL and POR then less favorable of (i) and (ii) to MIL; least favorable of WAS, PHL 9-30, BRK and PHX to PHX'. Spotrac simplifies to 'Most Favorable of WAS and BKN, PHI 9-30 and PHX (via BKN and WAS swap for PHX) or swap for MIL or POR'; RealGM wording preferred.

controls.swap_with: WAS holds a favorable right vs PHX ('via WAS swap for PHX'); MEM holds a right vs the less favorable of WAS/PHX ('via MEM swap for WAS or PHX'); PHX receives the least favorable of all
controls.notes: Swap-encumbered; WAS keeps the more favorable of WAS and PHX; its own pick can convey to MEM or PHX. RealGM exact: 'More favorable of WAS and PHX; more favorable of (i) MEM and (ii) less favorable of WAS and PHX to MEM then least favorable of all to PHX (via WAS swap for PHX; via MEM swap for WAS or PHX)'. Spotrac condenses to 'Most favorable of WAS, MEM and PHX'.
